content.title: Chapter 46 - HOUSING — Sec. 46-41. - Record of proceedings.
content.summary:
In the event of the removal of any commissioner, the mayor shall file in the office
               of the city clerk a record of the proceedings together with the charges made against
               the commissioners and findings thereon.
(Code 1981, § 14-11; Ord. No. 1248, § 6(4), 6-16-1975)
